ios.desc:
App Lock is a privacy app designed to help keep your sensitive apps private and secure on your device. With App Lock, you can easily block any app you want, ensuring that you remain private and out of sight from prying eyes.

The app features an intuitive and user-friendly interface that allows you to quickly and easily select the apps you want to lock. Once an app has been locked, nobody will be able to access your private data. 

App Lock is the perfect solution for anyone looking to ensure more privacy and security on your device.

* In order to use App Lock you need to purchase the Lilucat Pro which is an annual service that costs 29.99$. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and auto-renews at the same price unless disabled in iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your subscription can be managed in your iTunes Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

quotes.text:
Hey HN!

I’m Kevin, co-founder of Lilucat, a small indie team passionate about building privacy-focused and user-friendly products. Today, I’m excited to share one of our most popular projects: App Lock by Lilucat.

What is App Lock?
App Lock lets you securely lock and hide apps, photos, and videos on your iOS device. It’s designed to enhance privacy, protect sensitive data, and prevent unauthorized access. Here’s what it can do:

Lock any app instantly with your PIN or Face ID (password unlock coming soon).
Restrict device configurations, like blocking app installations or removals, preventing in-app purchases, and more.
Hide apps completely—hidden apps aren’t just removed from the home screen, they’re invisible in the App Library as well.
Why use App Lock?
Whether you’re safeguarding financial apps, securing personal data, or controlling what kids can access, App Lock provides an extra layer of privacy. It’s especially helpful for those in regions where using certain apps might put them at risk.

While iOS 18 introduced Face ID app locking, App Lock offers a more comprehensive solution—on iOS, hidden apps can still be found in a folder in the App Library, whereas with our app, hidden apps remain completely invisible unless unlocked through App Lock.

We’ve built this app with privacy at its core, and we’d love your feedback to keep improving!

You can find more info on App Lock by Lilucat here: https://lilucat.com/app-lock/
